verdict.rationale: Cline's first-party docs describe a headless CLI mode for CI/CD and scripting with processable output. They show auto-approve flags for unattended execution, stdin piping, and running inside GitHub Actions, GitLab, or any pipeline. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage, and in-depth docs such as a CI workflow example or exit-code/output-format specifics.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Run Cline in your terminal with interactive chat or fully headless automation for CI/CD and scripting.
Use headless mode for scripts/automation and processable output.
Run it headlessly inside GitHub Actions, GitLab, or any pipeline.
cline --auto-approve true "run tests and fix failures"
